For the host and person for whom the show is named, see Jeanine Pirro.

_Judge Jeanine Pirro_ was recorded in Chicago at NBC Tower, the NBC network's Chicago broadcast base and home to the related courtroom series _Judge Mathis_, and was produced by Telepictures Productions, distributed in syndication by Warner Bros.
Domestic Television Distribution.
Greg Mathis, who presides over the aforementioned _Judge Mathis_, served as this series' consultant.
Some reality television stars, along with a wrestler, appeared on the show during its run.
Honky Tonk Man was a witness for a defendant in a case; the others listed were plaintiffs in their respective cases.
